title: [Interaction between psychotic patients and AI-driven chatbots].
summary: In the last few years, the use of AI-driven chatbots has increased a lot. The interaction between psychotic patients and these types of systems may delay care, maintain and worsen delusions or even encourage potentially dangerous actions. Commercially available chatbots seem to lack the ability to identify psychotic symptoms in users. This underscores the need for spreading knowledge about the risks associated with this technology among caregivers, patients and their close ones.
